title: Pantheon RegimeState
description: First-class decision object that records the inferred market regime for a strategy evaluation window. This is stage 1 of the five-stage decision chain (RegimeState → UniverseSelection → SignalInference → AllocationDecision → RiskAdjudication). Regime classification drives all downstream selection, inference, and allocation logic.

regime_id.description: Unique identifier for this regime state evaluation.

strategy_id.description: The strategy this regime inference applies to.

artifact_id.description: The strategy/model artifact version that produced this regime inference.

version.description: Version of this regime state record.

regime_class.description: The inferred market regime classification. Drives universe selection and signal model choice downstream.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence score [0, 1]. Low confidence should flag regime_transition or mixed regimes.

regime_scores.description: Full probability distribution over all regime classes. regime_class should be the argmax.

evaluated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when this regime inference was computed.

window_start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp marking the start of the observation window used for regime inference.

window_end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp marking the end of the observation window used for regime inference.

ref_id.description: Identifier of the referenced object (e.g., dataset_version_id, security_master_id).

input_refs.description: Upstream data sources and feature sets consumed for regime inference. References BG-001 Data Plane objects where applicable.

ref_id.description: ID of the downstream object that consumed this regime state.

output_refs.description: Downstream decision objects that reference this regime state. Populated as the chain progresses.

model_family.description: The model family used for regime classification.

model_version.description: Version or commit of the regime classifier model.

training_dataset_ref.description: Optional reference to the dataset used to train the regime classifier.

model_ref.description: Model provenance for the regime inference. Distinguishes first-class decision provenance from raw research input.

decision_reasoning.description: Human- and machine-readable reasoning summary for the regime classification. May be a model-generated summary or structured feature importance snapshot.

feature_snapshot.description: Key feature values or summary statistics that drove the regime classification. Stored for replay and audit.

market_scope.description: The market and instrument scope this regime applies to. Should align with BG-000 market scope policy vocabulary.

asset_classes.description: Asset classes covered (e.g., equities, futures, crypto, fx).

markets.description: Market identifiers (e.g., US, TW, JP, global).

security_master_refs.description: SecurityMaster IDs this regime was inferred from. Links to BG-001 objects.

state.description: Lifecycle state of this regime state record.

superseded_by.description: regime_id of a newer regime state that supersedes this one.

persona_id.description: Optional: the persona this regime inference is scoped to.

capital_pool_id.description: Optional: the capital pool this regime inference applies to.

then.description: Low-confidence inferences should be classified as regime_transition or mixed to signal uncertainty to downstream consumers.
